about.title: About Golden Wheels
about.text: Golden Wheels Limited is an experienced used car dealer on Hagley Park Road, Kingston, importing quality vehicles from Japan, England, Canada, and the USA — all suitable for the Jamaican market. We offer special orders and extensive after-sale service. Get the premium purchasing experience with us! Call 876-849-4908 anytime except Saturdays.
